evidence.detail: the hack is still present: 'creatureland': 't:land -t:creature o:/becomes? a.* creature/ -"Argoth, Sanctum of Nature" -o:/target .* becomes/' — Argoth is excluded by name rather than by proper oracle-text scoping

the underlying cause is that meld card backs share oracle_text with the front in the DB, so any regex matching meld-back text also matches the front; fixing it properly requires querying face-scoped oracle text, which is not currently supported in the search layer

triage.notes: The workaround is fragile: any future meld land with 'becomes a creature' oracle text on the back would need to be manually excluded. A proper fix requires the search engine to scope oracle_text queries to specific card faces for meld cards, which is a non-trivial schema or query change.
